title: Lapsed Disposable Filter Months Under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** Under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, months of disposable filters (A7038) that lapsed before a coverage-billed line ships are dropped from the line and never shipped; the months dropped come off the months the line covers, never taking the months shipped below zero. They are counted as the whole calendar months from a lapse date to the ship date:

- when the filters on hand ran out **before** the refill was confirmed, the lapse date is the day the filter supply ran out;
- when they ran out **on or after** the day the refill was confirmed but before the ship date, the lapse date is the confirmation date;
- otherwise nothing is dropped.

## When the filter supply ran out

The filter supply runs out on the latest covered-through date among the enrollment's coverage-billed filter lines, a line a payer later took back still counting because its filters were delivered. This run-out date serves only the months dropped here; when a coverage-billed line may ship still follows the item's current covered-through date, from which a line a payer took back drops out. Where the enrollment has no coverage-billed filter line, nothing is dropped. The confirmation date is the contact date of the enrollment's latest refill confirmation.

## Table

| Filter supply ran out | Lapse date | Months dropped |
|---|---|---|
| before the confirmation date | the run-out day | whole months from the run-out day to the ship date |
| on or after the confirmation date, before the ship date | the confirmation date | whole months from the confirmation date to the ship date |
| on or after the ship date | — | none |

## Cases (hypothetical dates, ship date 15 March)

- Supply ran out 10 January; refill confirmed 20 January. Ran out before the confirmation: whole months from 10 January to 15 March are 2. Two months are dropped.
- Supply ran out 25 January; refill confirmed 20 January. Ran out after the confirmation and before the ship date: whole months from 20 January to 15 March are 1 (20 February completes one month; 20 March has not been reached). One month is dropped.
- Supply ran out 3 March; refill confirmed 1 March: whole months from 1 March to 15 March are 0. Nothing is dropped in effect.
- Supply runs out 20 March: after the ship date, nothing is dropped.
- The latest filter line was later taken back by the payer: it still counts for the run-out day.
